articles.title: MAIA: Interview of Guillaume Princen on Anthropic’s AI Strategy
articles.summary: In an interview on October 14, 2026, Anthropic’s Head of International Startups & Digital Native, Guillaume Princen, discussed how startups and major firms are adopting Anthropic’s AI, including Claude tools, to boost employee productivity, overhaul processes, and build new products. He highlighted growing demand for frontier models like Opus 5.5, now about 40% cheaper than its predecessor, and a shift toward using different models for specific tasks across the 5.5 family. Princen emphasized Anthropic’s safety-first approach versus open-source and open-weight competitors, underscoring third-party auditing, closer cooperation with governments, and willingness to delay or limit powerful model releases—such as with Methos—if safety concerns arise, even at the expense of near-term revenue. articles.title: Using ElevenLabs for Corporate Training Videos
articles.summary: Why Voice AI Is the New Frontier for Corporate Training When you think of corporate training, you probably picture slide decks, screen recordings, and a handful of presenters. That’s still a common approach, but it’s also one of the most tedious ways to deliver content. Employees spend hours watching the same video, and trainers spend countless hours re‑recording the same lesson in different formats. Enter text‑to‑speech (TTS) and voice cloning. With the right tools, you can transform static scripts into engaging, personalized audio that feels as natural as a real instructor. Not only does this cut production time, but it also opens up new possibilities for localization, accessibility, and interactive learning experiences. In this post, I’ll walk you through how to use a leading voice‑AI platform—ElevenLabs—to create high‑quality corporate training videos.
